subject: a single narrow weathered stone shrine standing alone, tall rather than wide, its heavy mossy roof and the thick cluster of knotted paper strips and plain blank wooden tablets hanging from its eaves crowded into the top of the frame, three small stone figures huddled high in the shadow under those eaves with faces worn smooth and blank and hands broken away, dark red cloth at their shoulders, a pale violet glow rising behind the roof ridge, the shrine narrowing and darkening as it descends until its base is lost in black
